message: Request: Write exactly two English emails introducing MarketingOS to invited early-access testers who already have a test account. They run a small SaaS business and need to write a launch or onboarding email campaign. Explain one concrete supported reason to try the product, then invite them to test one real offer and review the output. Do not assume their present tools, revenue, list size, staffing, email results or urgency. Do not invent prices, testimonials, performance gains or public signup. Make the first action small: sign in, add the real offer material, and request one email. In the second email explain why inspecting source facts and reader feedback is useful. One clear CTA in each email to their existing account. The product is MarketingOS, not the older orqAgent AI agent builder.
